verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents API tokens and standard OAuth 2.0/Bearer token support (fastmail-docs-2, fastmail-docs-5, fastmail-docs-41), and a community report confirms real-world scoped credentials in practice (an 'app password' restricted to SMTP-only access, fastmail-comm-11), plus runtime probes confirm the JMAP API is live and OAuth-gated (fastmail-probe-rt-1). However, there is no first-party documentation detailing granular scope/permission configuration for API tokens (e.g., read-only vs write, specific mailbox/account restrictions) tailored for agent use cases. Missing for 10: detailed docs on token scope granularity/permission levels, explicit agent-use-case guidance, and independent verification of scoping options beyond the single SMTP-only anecdote.
